paragraphs: I have run the night receiving bay at Panay Logistics for four years. On a bad week that is eleven trucks between six in the evening and two in the morning, and I have never missed a manifest handover.

I took two years out in 2020 to care for my mother while she was ill. I came back to the same shift and the same crew. That gap is the only one on this page and I would rather explain it than hide it.
What I want from this role is not more money. It is a supervisor who signs off on procedure instead of on charisma.
